blocks.en: An item is recognised as an **intangible asset** if it meets **(1) the definition** of an intangible asset and **(2) the recognition criteria**.
blocks.ms: Sesuatu item diiktiraf sebagai **aset tak ketara** jika memenuhi **(1) definisi** aset tak ketara dan **(2) kriteria pengiktirafan**.

en: It is **probable** that expected future economic benefits attributable to the asset will flow to the entity; AND
The **cost** of the asset can be **measured reliably**.
ms: Adalah **berkemungkinan besar** manfaat ekonomi masa depan yang boleh dikaitkan dengan aset akan mengalir kepada entiti; DAN
**Kos** aset boleh **diukur dengan pasti**.

blocks.en: Extra (para 8–12): an intangible asset is an identifiable non-monetary asset without physical substance. "Identifiable" = separable OR arises from contractual/legal rights; the entity must also control it.
blocks.ms: Tambahan (para 8–12): aset tak ketara ialah aset bukan kewangan yang boleh dikenal pasti tanpa bentuk fizikal. "Boleh dikenal pasti" = boleh diasingkan ATAU timbul daripada hak kontrak/undang-undang; entiti juga mesti mengawalnya.

blocks.en: Pattern: if you cannot SEPARATE it or CONTROL it, it is not an intangible asset. Expense it.
blocks.ms: Corak: jika tidak boleh DIASINGKAN atau DIKAWAL, ia bukan aset tak ketara. Belanjakan.

en: At the acquisition date the acquirer recognises **all identifiable assets** of the acquiree **separately from goodwill**.
An asset is **identifiable** if it is **separable** OR arises from **contractual or other legal rights**.
Recognise identifiable intangibles that the acquiree **had already recognised** AND those it **had not recognised**.
Intangibles not recognised by the acquiree may **become identifiable** by the acquirer at the date of acquisition.
**Measure at fair value at the acquisition date.**
ms: Pada tarikh perolehan pemerolehan (acquirer) mengiktiraf **semua aset boleh dikenal pasti** milik pihak diperoleh **berasingan daripada muhibah (goodwill)**.
Aset **boleh dikenal pasti** jika **boleh diasingkan** ATAU timbul daripada **hak kontrak atau undang-undang lain**.
Iktiraf aset tak ketara boleh dikenal pasti yang **sudah diiktiraf** pihak diperoleh DAN yang **belum diiktiraf**.
Aset tak ketara yang belum diiktiraf pihak diperoleh mungkin **menjadi boleh dikenal pasti** oleh acquirer pada tarikh perolehan.
**Ukur pada nilai saksama pada tarikh perolehan.**

blocks.en: Lecturer's notes on slides 8–9: "internally generated" intangibles of the acquiree (e.g. a brand) can be recognised by the acquirer in the combination; acquired brand is recognised at fair value.
blocks.ms: Nota pensyarah pada slide 8–9: aset tak ketara "dijana secara dalaman" milik pihak diperoleh (cth jenama) boleh diiktiraf oleh acquirer dalam penggabungan; jenama yang diperoleh diiktiraf pada nilai saksama.

en: Examples: a **timber concession** (legal right to log establishes an identifiable intangible) and a **toll concession** (right to collect toll while building and maintaining the highway).
**MFRS 120** applies: measure initially at **fair value** OR at **cost**.
At fair value: use a quoted price in an active market or other relevant determination of fair value.
At cost: recognise all costs of preparing the asset for its intended use.
ms: Contoh: **konsesi balak** (hak sah menebang mewujudkan aset tak ketara boleh dikenal pasti) dan **konsesi tol** (hak kutip tol sambil membina dan menyelenggara lebuh raya).
**MFRS 120** terpakai: ukur awal pada **nilai saksama** ATAU **kos**.
Pada nilai saksama: guna harga sebut harga dalam pasaran aktif atau penentuan nilai saksama lain yang relevan.
Pada kos: iktiraf semua kos menyediakan aset untuk kegunaan yang dimaksudkan.

blocks.en: Example 3.3: Rapid Row Bhd won a tender; on 1 January 2019 the government granted a 15-year licence to operate a tramway. Legal and other fees were RM110,000; there were no other costs. The fair value of a similar licence on 1 Jan 2019 is RM1 million.
blocks.ms: Contoh 3.3: Rapid Row Bhd menang tender; pada 1 Januari 2019 kerajaan beri lesen 15 tahun untuk mengendalikan trem. Yuran guaman dan lain-lain RM110,000; tiada kos lain. Nilai saksama lesen serupa pada 1 Jan 2019 ialah RM1 juta.

blocks.en: 31 Dec 2019 (fair value option)
blocks.ms: 31 Dis 2019 (pilihan nilai saksama)

blocks.en: Amortisation = 1,000,000 ÷ 15 = RM66,667. Revenue recognised = 990,000 ÷ 15 = RM66,000.
blocks.ms: Pelunasan = 1,000,000 ÷ 15 = RM66,667. Hasil diiktiraf = 990,000 ÷ 15 = RM66,000.

blocks.en: At 31 Dec 2019: licence carrying amount = 1,000,000 − 66,667 = 933,333; deferred revenue balance = 990,000 − 66,000 = 924,000.
blocks.ms: Pada 31 Dis 2019: amaun dibawa lesen = 1,000,000 − 66,667 = 933,333; baki hasil tertunda = 990,000 − 66,000 = 924,000.

title.ms: Aset Tak Ketara Dijana Secara Dalaman

blocks.en: Almost all internally generated intangibles are **not recognised** because there are uncertainties about **identifiability and control**. Only part of **R&D** may be recognised.
blocks.ms: Hampir semua aset tak ketara yang dijana secara dalaman **tidak diiktiraf** kerana ketidakpastian tentang **boleh dikenal pasti dan kawalan**. Hanya sebahagian **R&D** boleh diiktiraf.

blocks.en: Prohibited from recognition
blocks.ms: Dilarang diiktiraf

en: Customer base
Market share
Non-union status
Outstanding credit ratings
Ongoing training or recruiting programme
ms: Pangkalan pelanggan
Bahagian pasaran
Status bukan kesatuan
Penarafan kredit cemerlang
Program latihan atau pengambilan berterusan

blocks.en: Extra (para 63): internally generated brands, mastheads, publishing titles and customer lists are also not recognised.
blocks.ms: Tambahan (para 63): jenama, kepala akhbar, tajuk penerbitan dan senarai pelanggan yang dijana dalaman juga tidak diiktiraf.

blocks.en: The company must **separate the research phase from the development phase**.
blocks.ms: Syarikat mesti **mengasingkan fasa penyelidikan daripada fasa pembangunan**.

en: **Research phase:** all expenditure is **expensed when incurred**.
**Development phase:** expenditure is **capitalised** as an intangible asset **if conditions are met** (para 57).
ms: **Fasa penyelidikan:** semua perbelanjaan **dibelanjakan apabila ditanggung**.
**Fasa pembangunan:** perbelanjaan **dikapitalkan** sebagai aset tak ketara **jika syarat dipenuhi** (para 57).

blocks.en: Conditions for capitalising development (para 57)
blocks.ms: Syarat mengkapitalkan pembangunan (para 57)

en: **Technical feasibility** of completing the asset, and the **intention and ability** to use or sell it.
The **means** by which probable future economic benefits will be generated, and **availability of resources** to complete the development.
The **ability to measure** the development expenditure reliably.
ms: **Kebolehlaksanaan teknikal** menyiapkan aset, dan **niat serta keupayaan** menggunakan atau menjualnya.
**Cara** manfaat ekonomi masa depan akan dijana, dan **ketersediaan sumber** untuk menyiapkan pembangunan.
**Keupayaan mengukur** perbelanjaan pembangunan dengan pasti.

blocks.en: The standard lists six criteria (technical feasibility; intention to complete; ability to use or sell; probable future benefits; adequate resources; reliable measurement). The slide groups them into three bullets.
blocks.ms: Piawaian senaraikan enam kriteria (kebolehlaksanaan teknikal; niat menyiapkan; keupayaan guna atau jual; manfaat masa depan berkemungkinan; sumber mencukupi; pengukuran boleh dipercayai). Slide kumpulkannya dalam tiga poin.

blocks.en: Class exercise, Example 3.4 (Presto Bhd): a 12-month project to design a filtration system for air-conditioning units, with monthly costs: salaries for basic tests on existing filters (RM145,000); a basic model (RM165,000) later found ineffective; purchase of patent SPRING360 (RM330,000); revising the design (RM135,000); a prototype (RM65,000); demonstrations to prospective customers (RM25,000, including RM12,000 for food and beverages).
blocks.ms: Latihan kelas, Contoh 3.4 (Presto Bhd): projek 12 bulan mereka bentuk sistem penapisan untuk unit penyaman udara, dengan kos bulanan: gaji ujian asas penapis sedia ada (RM145,000); model asas (RM165,000) kemudian didapati tidak berkesan; pembelian paten SPRING360 (RM330,000); menyemak reka bentuk (RM135,000); prototaip (RM65,000); demonstrasi kepada bakal pelanggan (RM25,000, termasuk RM12,000 makanan dan minuman).

blocks.en: The slide shows the case only. Think: which costs are research (expense), which are development (capitalise once all criteria are met), which is a separately acquired patent, and which are selling/marketing (expense)? Confirm the textbook answer with your lecturer.
blocks.ms: Slide hanya tunjuk kes. Fikirkan: kos mana penyelidikan (belanja), mana pembangunan (kapital bila semua kriteria dipenuhi), mana paten dibeli berasingan, dan mana jualan/pemasaran (belanja)? Sahkan jawapan buku teks dengan pensyarah.

blocks.en: Subsequent expenditure is capitalised **only** if it increases future economic benefits **beyond the originally assessed standard of performance**. Most is expensed because:
blocks.ms: Perbelanjaan selepas pengiktirafan dikapitalkan **hanya** jika ia menambah manfaat ekonomi masa depan **melebihi tahap prestasi asal**. Kebanyakannya dibelanjakan kerana:

en: Its purpose is to **maintain** expected benefits rather than increase them.
Intangibles have **no replacement of parts or additions**.
It is **hard to attribute** the spending to a particular intangible rather than the business as a whole.
ms: Tujuannya ialah **mengekalkan** manfaat dijangka, bukan menambah.
Aset tak ketara **tiada penggantian bahagian atau tambahan**.
**Sukar dikaitkan** perbelanjaan itu kepada aset tak ketara tertentu berbanding perniagaan keseluruhan.

blocks.en: Example: legal fees to defend rights over a trademark are commonly expensed under MFRS 138, except rarely when they increase future benefits.
blocks.ms: Contoh: yuran guaman mempertahankan hak ke atas tanda dagangan lazimnya dibelanjakan di bawah MFRS 138, kecuali jarang apabila ia menambah manfaat masa depan.

en: An intangible with a **finite life** is **amortised** over its useful life.

The **Clarification of Acceptable Methods of Depreciation and Amortisation** (amendments to MFRS 116 and MFRS 138) clarifies the possibility of using **revenue generated by an activity** as the amortisation method for intangibles.
Capitalised **development costs**: MFRS 138 sets **no maximum period**, but **in practice not more than five years**.
The **life is reviewed at each reporting period** for a significant change in the expected pattern of benefits.
A change in useful life is a **change in estimate** (MFRS 108), accounted for **prospectively**.
ms: Aset tak ketara dengan **hayat terhad** **dilunaskan** sepanjang hayat berguna.
**Penjelasan Kaedah Susut Nilai dan Pelunasan yang Diterima** (pindaan MFRS 116 dan MFRS 138) menjelaskan kemungkinan guna **hasil yang dijana oleh aktiviti** sebagai kaedah pelunasan.
**Kos pembangunan** dikapitalkan: MFRS 138 **tiada tempoh maksimum**, tetapi **dalam praktik tidak melebihi lima tahun**.
**Hayat disemak pada setiap tempoh pelaporan** untuk perubahan ketara corak manfaat dijangka.
Perubahan hayat berguna ialah **perubahan anggaran** (MFRS 108), diakaunkan **secara prospektif**.

blocks.en: Extra: the amendments say a revenue-based method is presumed inappropriate, unless the intangible is expressed as a measure of revenue or revenue and consumption of benefits are highly correlated. An intangible with an **indefinite** life is **not amortised**.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: pindaan kata kaedah berasaskan hasil dianggap tidak sesuai, kecuali aset tak ketara dinyatakan sebagai ukuran hasil atau hasil dan penggunaan manfaat sangat berkorelasi. Aset tak ketara dengan hayat **tidak terhad** **tidak dilunaskan**.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers; the slide gives none): capitalised development cost RM300,000, amortised straight-line over 5 years. After 2 years the remaining life is revised to 2 more years.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri; slide tiada nombor): kos pembangunan dikapitalkan RM300,000, dilunaskan garis lurus 5 tahun. Selepas 2 tahun baki hayat disemak kepada 2 tahun lagi.

blocks.en: Years 1–2: 300,000 ÷ 5 = 60,000 a year. Carrying amount after 2 years = 300,000 − 120,000 = 180,000. From year 3 (prospective): 180,000 ÷ 2 = RM90,000 a year. Prior years are NOT restated.
blocks.ms: Tahun 1–2: 300,000 ÷ 5 = 60,000 setahun. Amaun dibawa selepas 2 tahun = 300,000 − 120,000 = 180,000. Dari tahun 3 (prospektif): 180,000 ÷ 2 = RM90,000 setahun. Tahun lalu TIDAK dinyatakan semula.

en: Type
When to test for impairment
ms: Jenis
Bila uji rosot nilai

en: Finite life
Only when there is an indication of impairment
ms: Hayat terhad
Hanya bila ada petunjuk rosot nilai

en: Indefinite life
Annually
ms: Hayat tidak terhad
Setiap tahun

en: Goodwill
Tested through the impairment of its related cash-generating unit (CGU)
ms: Goodwill
Diuji melalui rosot nilai unit penjana tunai (CGU) berkaitan

blocks.en: Extra: an intangible not yet available for use (e.g. development in progress) is also tested annually. Impairment mechanics are in MFRS 136.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: aset tak ketara belum sedia digunakan (cth pembangunan sedang berjalan) juga diuji setiap tahun. Mekanik rosot nilai dalam MFRS 136.

en: Entity chooses between the **cost model** and the **revaluation model**.
**Cost model:** initial cost − accumulated amortisation − accumulated impairment losses.
**Revaluation model:** fair value at the end of a financial period.
The revaluation model can be used **only if fair value can be determined by reference to an active market**.
ms: Entiti pilih antara **model kos** dan **model penilaian semula**.
**Model kos:** kos awal − pelunasan terkumpul − rosot nilai terkumpul.
**Model penilaian semula:** nilai saksama pada akhir tempoh kewangan.
Model penilaian semula boleh digunakan **hanya jika nilai saksama boleh ditentukan dengan merujuk pasaran aktif**.

blocks.en: Active markets for intangibles are rare (patents, licences and brands are unique), so the cost model is the norm.
blocks.ms: Pasaran aktif untuk aset tak ketara jarang ada (paten, lesen dan jenama unik), jadi model kos ialah kebiasaan.

en: Remove an intangible from the statement of financial position when it is **sold** or when **no further future benefits** are expected.
Examples: selling a copyright held for three years; disposing of a patent that is no longer beneficial.
**Gain or loss = proceeds received − current carrying amount** (profit or loss).
ms: Keluarkan aset tak ketara daripada penyata kedudukan kewangan bila ia **dijual** atau **tiada manfaat masa depan** dijangka.
Contoh: menjual hak cipta yang dipegang tiga tahun; melupuskan paten yang tidak lagi berguna.
**Untung atau rugi = hasil diterima − amaun dibawa semasa** (untung atau rugi).

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): copyright with carrying amount RM40,000 sold for RM55,000 → gain RM15,000. Dr Bank 55,000; Cr Copyright 40,000; Cr Gain on disposal 15,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): hak cipta amaun dibawa RM40,000 dijual RM55,000 → untung RM15,000. Dr Bank 55,000; Cr Hak cipta 40,000; Cr Untung pelupusan 15,000.

en: **Amortisation:** useful lives and amortisation methods.
**Reasons** supporting the assessment of an **indefinite life**.
**Revaluation:** methods used in estimating fair values.
**Gross carrying amount, accumulated impairment and accumulated amortisation** at the beginning and end of the period.
ms: **Pelunasan:** hayat berguna dan kaedah pelunasan.
**Sebab** menyokong penilaian **hayat tidak terhad**.
**Penilaian semula:** kaedah anggaran nilai saksama.
**Amaun dibawa kasar, rosot nilai terkumpul dan pelunasan terkumpul** pada awal dan akhir tempoh.

blocks.en: Issues involving R&D
blocks.ms: Isu melibatkan R&D

en: **Identifying the phases:** hard to separate research from development.
**High research cost cannot be capitalised** though success is uncertain.
**Multiple projects** at different phases in the same period complicate accounting.
**Disclosure** of R&D may reveal competitive advantages.
ms: **Mengenal pasti fasa:** sukar membezakan penyelidikan daripada pembangunan.
**Kos penyelidikan tinggi tidak boleh dikapitalkan** walaupun kejayaan tidak pasti.
**Banyak projek** pada fasa berbeza dalam tempoh sama merumitkan perakaunan.
**Pendedahan** R&D mungkin mendedahkan kelebihan daya saing.

blocks.en: Issues involving internally generated intangibles
blocks.ms: Isu melibatkan aset tak ketara dijana dalaman

en: **Non-recognition** creates a gap between book value and true economic value (e.g. service and hospitality firms rely on customer service and marketing).
**Different treatment** of acquired vs internally generated intangibles although they are the same economically.
**Control:** internally developed practices/systems can be copied by others.
**Valuation** issues.
ms: **Tidak diiktiraf** mewujudkan jurang antara nilai buku dan nilai ekonomi sebenar (cth firma perkhidmatan dan hospitaliti bergantung pada khidmat pelanggan dan pemasaran).
**Layanan berbeza** untuk aset tak ketara diperoleh vs dijana dalaman walaupun sama dari segi ekonomi.
**Kawalan:** amalan/sistem dibangunkan dalaman boleh ditiru pihak lain.
Isu **penilaian**.

q.ms: Kriteria pengiktirafan aset tak ketara

a.ms: Memenuhi definisi DAN: manfaat ekonomi masa depan berkemungkinan DAN kos boleh diukur dengan pasti.

q.ms: Apa maksud "boleh dikenal pasti"?

a.ms: Boleh diasingkan ATAU timbul daripada hak kontrak/undang-undang.

a.ms: Paten dan hak cipta; francais dan konsesi; tanda dagangan.

a.ms: Nilai saksama pada tarikh perolehan, diiktiraf berasingan daripada goodwill.

q.en: Which acquiree intangibles does the acquirer recognise?
q.ms: Aset tak ketara pihak diperoleh mana yang acquirer iktiraf?

a.en: Those already recognised AND those not recognised by the acquiree.
a.ms: Yang sudah DAN yang belum diiktiraf pihak diperoleh.

q.en: Two measurement options for an intangible from a government grant
q.ms: Dua pilihan pengukuran aset tak ketara daripada geran kerajaan

a.en: Fair value OR cost (MFRS 120).
a.ms: Nilai saksama ATAU kos (MFRS 120).

q.en: Timber concession / toll concession: asset or not?
q.ms: Konsesi balak / konsesi tol: aset atau bukan?

a.en: Identifiable intangible assets: the rights are legally established.
a.ms: Aset tak ketara boleh dikenal pasti: hak ditubuhkan secara sah.

q.en: Journal for a licence at fair value (FV 1,000,000; fees 110,000)
q.ms: Jurnal lesen pada nilai saksama (FV 1,000,000; yuran 110,000)

a.en: Dr Licence 1,000,000; Cr Cash 110,000; Cr Deferred revenue 990,000.
a.ms: Dr Lesen 1,000,000; Cr Tunai 110,000; Cr Hasil tertunda 990,000.

q.en: Examples of internally generated intangibles not recognised
q.ms: Contoh aset tak ketara dijana dalaman tidak diiktiraf

a.en: Customer base, market share, non-union status, outstanding credit ratings, ongoing training/recruiting programme.
a.ms: Pangkalan pelanggan, bahagian pasaran, status bukan kesatuan, penarafan kredit cemerlang, program latihan/pengambilan.

q.ms: Fasa pembangunan: perakaunan

a.en: Capitalise as an intangible if the para 57 conditions are met.
a.ms: Kapitalkan sebagai aset tak ketara jika syarat para 57 dipenuhi.

q.en: Development capitalisation conditions (slide version)
q.ms: Syarat kapitalisasi pembangunan (versi slide)

a.en: 1) Technical feasibility + intention and ability to use/sell; 2) Means to generate benefits + resources available; 3) Reliable measurement.
a.ms: 1) Kebolehlaksanaan teknikal + niat dan keupayaan guna/jual; 2) Cara jana manfaat + sumber tersedia; 3) Pengukuran boleh dipercayai.

q.en: When can subsequent expenditure be capitalised?
q.ms: Bila perbelanjaan susulan boleh dikapitalkan?

a.en: Only if it increases future benefits beyond the originally assessed standard of performance.
a.ms: Hanya jika ia menambah manfaat masa depan melebihi tahap prestasi asal.

q.en: Why are most subsequent costs expensed?
q.ms: Kenapa kebanyakan kos susulan dibelanjakan?

a.en: They maintain benefits; no replacement of parts; hard to attribute to a specific intangible.
a.ms: Ia mengekalkan manfaat; tiada penggantian bahagian; sukar dikaitkan kepada aset tertentu.

q.en: Maximum amortisation period for capitalised development?
q.ms: Tempoh pelunasan maksimum untuk pembangunan dikapitalkan?

a.en: MFRS 138 sets none, but in practice not more than five years.
a.ms: MFRS 138 tiada, tetapi dalam praktik tidak melebihi lima tahun.

q.en: Change in useful life: treatment
q.ms: Perubahan hayat berguna: layanan

a.en: Change in estimate (MFRS 108), applied prospectively; review life each reporting period.
a.ms: Perubahan anggaran (MFRS 108), dilaksana secara prospektif; semak hayat setiap tempoh pelaporan.

q.en: Indefinite-life intangible: amortised?
q.ms: Aset tak ketara hayat tidak terhad: dilunaskan?

a.en: No. It is tested for impairment annually.
a.ms: Tidak. Ia diuji rosot nilai setiap tahun.

q.en: Impairment test: finite life
q.ms: Ujian rosot nilai: hayat terhad

a.en: Only when there is an indication of impairment.
a.ms: Hanya bila ada petunjuk rosot nilai.

q.en: Impairment test: goodwill
q.ms: Ujian rosot nilai: goodwill

a.en: Through the related cash-generating unit (CGU).
a.ms: Melalui unit penjana tunai (CGU) berkaitan.

q.en: When can the revaluation model be used for intangibles?
q.ms: Bila model penilaian semula boleh digunakan untuk aset tak ketara?

a.en: Only if fair value can be determined by reference to an active market.
a.ms: Hanya jika nilai saksama boleh ditentukan dengan merujuk pasaran aktif.

q.en: Gain/loss on derecognition
q.ms: Untung/rugi semasa nyahpengiktirafan

a.en: Proceeds − carrying amount → profit or loss.
a.ms: Hasil − amaun dibawa → untung atau rugi.

q.en: Disclosures for amortisation and indefinite life
q.ms: Pendedahan pelunasan dan hayat tidak terhad

a.en: Useful lives and methods; reasons supporting an indefinite life.
a.ms: Hayat berguna dan kaedah; sebab menyokong hayat tidak terhad.

q.en: Why does non-recognition of internally generated intangibles matter?
q.ms: Kenapa tidak mengiktiraf aset tak ketara dijana dalaman penting?

a.en: It creates a gap between book value and true economic value, especially for service firms.
a.ms: Ia mewujudkan jurang antara nilai buku dan nilai ekonomi sebenar, terutama firma perkhidmatan.

q.en: Which pair are the recognition criteria for an intangible asset?
q.ms: Pasangan manakah kriteria pengiktirafan aset tak ketara?

o: Probable future benefits and reliably measurable cost
Purchase from a third party and fair value

e.en: Probable future economic benefits AND cost measured reliably.
e.ms: Manfaat ekonomi masa depan berkemungkinan DAN kos boleh diukur dengan pasti.

q.en: An asset is identifiable if it is:
q.ms: Aset boleh dikenal pasti jika ia:

o: Separable or arises from contractual or other legal rights

e.en: Separable OR arises from legal/contractual rights.
e.ms: Boleh diasingkan ATAU timbul daripada hak undang-undang/kontrak.

q.en: Which is an example of an intangible asset?
q.ms: Yang manakah contoh aset tak ketara?

e.en: Franchises and concessions are intangibles.
e.ms: Francais dan konsesi ialah aset tak ketara.

q.en: Advertising costs are not recognised as intangibles because:
q.ms: Kos pengiklanan tidak diiktiraf sebagai aset tak ketara kerana:

o: It is difficult to objectively determine the existence or life of future benefits

e.en: Benefits are too uncertain to measure objectively.
e.ms: Manfaat terlalu tidak pasti untuk diukur secara objektif.

q.en: An internally developed customer list is not recognised mainly because:
q.ms: Senarai pelanggan dijana dalaman tidak diiktiraf terutamanya kerana:

o: The company lacks legal rights over customers and cannot control them

e.en: Inability to control the customers is the factor.
e.ms: Ketidakupayaan mengawal pelanggan ialah faktornya.

q.en: In a business combination the acquirer measures an identifiable intangible of the acquiree at:
q.ms: Dalam penggabungan perniagaan acquirer mengukur aset tak ketara boleh dikenal pasti pihak diperoleh pada:

o: Fair value at the acquisition date

e.en: Fair value at the acquisition date.
e.ms: Nilai saksama pada tarikh perolehan.

q.en: In a business combination the acquirer recognises identifiable intangibles:
q.ms: Dalam penggabungan perniagaan acquirer mengiktiraf aset tak ketara boleh dikenal pasti:

o: Only those the acquiree already recognised
Only those the acquiree had not recognised
Both those recognised and not recognised by the acquiree, separately from goodwill

e.en: All identifiable assets are recognised separately from goodwill.
e.ms: Semua aset boleh dikenal pasti diiktiraf berasingan daripada goodwill.

q.en: Which standard applies to an intangible acquired by government grant?
q.ms: Piawaian mana terpakai untuk aset tak ketara diperoleh melalui geran kerajaan?

e.en: MFRS 120 Government Grants.
e.ms: MFRS 120 Government Grants.

q.en: Rapid Row Bhd records the licence at fair value of RM1,000,000 and pays RM110,000 in fees. The credit to deferred revenue is:
q.ms: Rapid Row Bhd rekod lesen pada nilai saksama RM1,000,000 dan bayar yuran RM110,000. Kredit kepada hasil tertunda:

e.en: Dr Licence 1,000,000; Cr Cash 110,000; Cr Deferred revenue 990,000.
e.ms: Dr Lesen 1,000,000; Cr Tunai 110,000; Cr Hasil tertunda 990,000.

q.en: A 15-year licence is recorded at RM1,000,000. Amortisation for the first year is:
q.ms: Lesen 15 tahun direkod pada RM1,000,000. Pelunasan tahun pertama:

q.en: Same licence (deferred revenue RM990,000, 15 years). Revenue recognised in year 1 is:
q.ms: Lesen sama (hasil tertunda RM990,000, 15 tahun). Hasil diiktiraf tahun 1:

q.en: Which internally generated item is prohibited from recognition?
q.ms: Item dijana dalaman mana dilarang diiktiraf?

e.en: Customer base, market share etc. are prohibited.
e.ms: Pangkalan pelanggan, bahagian pasaran dll dilarang.

q.en: Expenditure incurred in the research phase is:
q.ms: Perbelanjaan fasa penyelidikan:

e.en: Research is always expensed.
e.ms: Penyelidikan sentiasa dibelanjakan.

q.en: Development expenditure is capitalised if:
q.ms: Perbelanjaan pembangunan dikapitalkan jika:

o: The para 57 conditions (feasibility, resources, reliable measurement, etc.) are met

e.en: All para 57 conditions must be met.
e.ms: Semua syarat para 57 mesti dipenuhi.

q.en: Which is NOT a condition for capitalising development expenditure?
q.ms: Yang manakah BUKAN syarat kapitalisasi perbelanjaan pembangunan?

o: Technical feasibility of completing the asset
The research phase cost less than RM1 million
Ability to measure the expenditure reliably

e.en: There is no cost ceiling for the research phase.
e.ms: Tiada had kos untuk fasa penyelidikan.

q.en: Subsequent expenditure on an intangible is capitalised only if it:
q.ms: Perbelanjaan susulan atas aset tak ketara dikapitalkan hanya jika ia:

o: Increases future benefits beyond the originally assessed standard of performance

e.en: Capitalise only when it improves beyond original standard.
e.ms: Kapital hanya bila meningkatkan melebihi tahap asal.

q.en: Legal fees to defend rights over a trademark are usually:
q.ms: Yuran guaman mempertahankan hak ke atas tanda dagangan biasanya:

e.en: Commonly expensed (they maintain rather than increase benefits).
e.ms: Lazimnya dibelanjakan (mengekalkan, bukan menambah manfaat).

q.en: In practice, capitalised development costs are amortised over a period that does not exceed:
q.ms: Dalam praktik, kos pembangunan dikapitalkan dilunaskan dalam tempoh tidak melebihi:

e.en: MFRS 138 sets no maximum, but in practice not more than five years.
e.ms: MFRS 138 tiada maksimum, tetapi dalam praktik tidak melebihi lima tahun.

q.en: A change in the useful life of an intangible is accounted for:
q.ms: Perubahan hayat berguna aset tak ketara diakaunkan:

o: As a change in estimate, prospectively

e.en: Change in estimate (MFRS 108), prospectively.
e.ms: Perubahan anggaran (MFRS 108), prospektif.

q.en: Development cost RM300,000 is amortised over 5 years. After 2 years the remaining life becomes 2 years. Amortisation for year 3 is:
q.ms: Kos pembangunan RM300,000 dilunaskan 5 tahun. Selepas 2 tahun baki hayat jadi 2 tahun. Pelunasan tahun 3:

e.en: Carrying amount 180,000 ÷ 2 = 90,000 (prospective).
e.ms: Amaun dibawa 180,000 ÷ 2 = 90,000 (prospektif).

q.en: An intangible asset with an indefinite useful life is:
q.ms: Aset tak ketara hayat tidak terhad:

o: Not amortised but tested for impairment annually

e.en: Not amortised; annual impairment test.
e.ms: Tidak dilunaskan; ujian rosot nilai tahunan.

q.en: For an intangible asset with a finite life, impairment testing is done:
q.ms: Bagi aset tak ketara hayat terhad, ujian rosot nilai dibuat:

o: Only when there is an indication of impairment

e.en: Only upon an indication of impairment.
e.ms: Hanya apabila ada petunjuk rosot nilai.

q.en: Goodwill is tested for impairment through:
q.ms: Goodwill diuji rosot nilai melalui:

e.en: CGU impairment.
e.ms: Rosot nilai CGU.

q.en: The revaluation model for intangibles can only be used if fair value is determined by reference to:
q.ms: Model penilaian semula untuk aset tak ketara hanya boleh digunakan jika nilai saksama ditentukan dengan merujuk:

e.en: Active market is required.
e.ms: Pasaran aktif diperlukan.

q.en: A copyright with carrying amount RM40,000 is sold for RM55,000. The result is:
q.ms: Hak cipta amaun dibawa RM40,000 dijual RM55,000. Keputusan:

o: Gain RM15,000 in profit or loss

q.en: An intangible is derecognised when:
q.ms: Aset tak ketara dinyahiktiraf apabila:

o: It is sold or no future benefits are expected

e.en: On disposal or when no future benefits are expected.
e.ms: Semasa pelupusan atau bila tiada manfaat masa depan dijangka.

q.en: Which is a required disclosure for intangibles?
q.ms: Yang manakah pendedahan wajib untuk aset tak ketara?

e.en: Useful lives and amortisation methods are disclosed.
e.ms: Hayat berguna dan kaedah pelunasan didedahkan.

q.en: Which is an issue involving R&D accounting?
q.ms: Yang manakah isu melibatkan perakaunan R&D?

o: Easy to separate research from development
High research cost cannot be capitalised even though success is uncertain

e.en: The research-phase cost cannot be capitalised.
e.ms: Kos fasa penyelidikan tidak boleh dikapitalkan.

q.en: Explain the recognition criteria for an intangible asset and give three examples of intangibles.
q.ms: Terangkan kriteria pengiktirafan aset tak ketara dan beri tiga contoh.

en: Meets the definition of an intangible asset (1)
Probable future economic benefits will flow to the entity (1)
Cost can be measured reliably (1)
Examples: patents/copyrights (1)
Franchises/concessions and trademarks (1)
ms: Memenuhi definisi aset tak ketara (1)
Manfaat ekonomi masa depan berkemungkinan mengalir kepada entiti (1)
Kos boleh diukur dengan pasti (1)
Contoh: paten/hak cipta (1)
Francais/konsesi dan tanda dagangan (1)

q.en: Explain the accounting treatment for research and development expenditure, including the conditions for capitalising development costs.
q.ms: Terangkan layanan perakaunan perbelanjaan penyelidikan dan pembangunan, termasuk syarat mengkapitalkan kos pembangunan.

en: Separate research from development phase (1)
Research: expense when incurred (1)
Development: capitalise if conditions are met (1)
Technical feasibility to complete and intention/ability to use or sell (2)
Means to generate probable future benefits; resources available (2)
Ability to measure the expenditure reliably (1)
ms: Asingkan fasa penyelidikan daripada pembangunan (1)
Penyelidikan: belanjakan apabila ditanggung (1)
Pembangunan: kapitalkan jika syarat dipenuhi (1)
Kebolehlaksanaan teknikal menyiapkan dan niat/keupayaan guna atau jual (2)
Cara jana manfaat masa depan berkemungkinan; sumber tersedia (2)
Keupayaan mengukur perbelanjaan dengan pasti (1)

q.en: On 1 January 20x1 the government grants Alpha Bhd a 10-year licence. Alpha pays RM50,000 in fees. A similar licence has a fair value of RM800,000. Alpha chooses fair value. Show the journals on 1 January 20x1 and for the year ended 31 December 20x1.
q.ms: Pada 1 Januari 20x1 kerajaan beri Alpha Bhd lesen 10 tahun. Alpha bayar yuran RM50,000. Lesen serupa ada nilai saksama RM800,000. Alpha pilih nilai saksama. Tunjukkan jurnal pada 1 Januari 20x1 dan bagi tahun berakhir 31 Disember 20x1.

en: Dr Licence 800,000 (2)
Cr Cash 50,000 (1)
Cr Deferred revenue 750,000 (1)
Dr Amortisation expense 80,000; Cr Accumulated amortisation 80,000 (1)
Release = 750,000 ÷ 10 = 75,000; Dr Deferred revenue, Cr Revenue 75,000 (2)
ms: Dr Lesen 800,000 (2)
Cr Tunai 50,000 (1)
Cr Hasil tertunda 750,000 (1)
Dr Belanja pelunasan 80,000; Cr Pelunasan terkumpul 80,000 (1)
Pelepasan = 750,000 ÷ 10 = 75,000; Dr Hasil tertunda, Cr Hasil 75,000 (2)

q.en: Discuss the amortisation of intangible assets, including how a change in useful life is treated.
q.ms: Bincangkan pelunasan aset tak ketara, termasuk cara perubahan hayat berguna dilayan.

en: Finite life: amortise over useful life (1)
Indefinite life: not amortised; annual impairment test (1)
Capitalised development: no maximum period, usually not more than five years (1)
Review life each reporting period (1)
Change in life = change in estimate (MFRS 108) (1)
Applied prospectively; prior years not restated (1)
ms: Hayat terhad: lunaskan sepanjang hayat berguna (1)
Hayat tidak terhad: tidak dilunaskan; ujian rosot nilai tahunan (1)
Pembangunan dikapitalkan: tiada tempoh maksimum, biasanya tidak melebihi lima tahun (1)
Semak hayat setiap tempoh pelaporan (1)
Perubahan hayat = perubahan anggaran (MFRS 108) (1)
Dilaksana secara prospektif; tahun lalu tidak dinyatakan semula (1)

q.en: Discuss two issues in accounting for internally generated intangibles.
q.ms: Bincangkan dua isu dalam perakaunan aset tak ketara dijana dalaman.

en: Non-recognition creates a gap between book value and true economic value (2)
Service/hospitality firms rely on customer service and marketing (1)
Different treatment of acquired vs internally generated intangibles (1)
Control: practices/systems can be replicated by others (1)
Valuation difficulties (1)
ms: Tidak diiktiraf mewujudkan jurang antara nilai buku dan nilai ekonomi sebenar (2)
Firma perkhidmatan/hospitaliti bergantung pada khidmat pelanggan dan pemasaran (1)
Layanan berbeza untuk aset tak ketara diperoleh vs dijana dalaman (1)
Kawalan: amalan/sistem boleh ditiru pihak lain (1)
Kesukaran penilaian (1)

q.en: Is it identifiable (separable or from legal/contractual rights), controlled by the entity, and without physical substance?
q.ms: Adakah ia boleh dikenal pasti (boleh diasingkan atau daripada hak undang-undang/kontrak), dikawal entiti, dan tanpa bentuk fizikal?

q.en: Was it generated internally (not purchased or acquired in a combination)?
q.ms: Adakah ia dijana secara dalaman (bukan dibeli atau diperoleh dalam penggabungan)?

q.en: Is it an internally generated brand, customer list, customer base, market share, training or similar?
q.ms: Adakah ia jenama, senarai pelanggan, pangkalan pelanggan, bahagian pasaran, latihan dijana dalaman atau serupa?

q.en: Is the spending in the research phase?
q.ms: Adakah perbelanjaan itu dalam fasa penyelidikan?

q.en: Are ALL development conditions met (feasibility, intention, ability, future benefits, resources, reliable measurement)?
q.ms: Adakah SEMUA syarat pembangunan dipenuhi (kebolehlaksanaan, niat, keupayaan, manfaat masa depan, sumber, pengukuran boleh dipercayai)?

q.en: Are future benefits probable AND is cost/fair value reliably measurable?
q.ms: Adakah manfaat masa depan berkemungkinan DAN kos/nilai saksama boleh diukur dengan pasti?

d.en: Purchased: at cost. Business combination: at fair value. Government grant: fair value or cost (MFRS 120).
d.ms: Dibeli: pada kos. Penggabungan perniagaan: nilai saksama. Geran kerajaan: nilai saksama atau kos (MFRS 120).

d.en: Development costs after all conditions are met; amortise (in practice ≤ 5 years).
d.ms: Kos pembangunan selepas semua syarat dipenuhi; lunaskan (dalam praktik ≤ 5 tahun).

d.en: Recognition is prohibited or the criteria are not met.
d.ms: Pengiktirafan dilarang atau kriteria tidak dipenuhi.

d.en: Check other standards (PPE, inventory, financial instrument).
d.ms: Semak piawaian lain (PPE, inventori, instrumen kewangan).
